notlar: Bug-fix release, and one of these was serious. WEAPONS WERE ONLY HALF-PATCHED: a weapon is several meshes - distance bands - and IMPORT 3D was writing only the closest one, so your model showed up close and the original came back the moment the camera pulled away in a fight. Across the catalogue 249 of 364 mesh entries were never written, and the tool still said SUCCESS. It now writes every band the game draws. REVERT NOW REALLY RESTORES: the archive is trimmed back to its original size and the report says how many bytes came off, instead of claiming 'restored' while the file kept growing. A PATCHED ENTRY IS NO LONGER LOCKED after a game update - the stale record is cleared and you can install again. Editing a part that other items share now warns you, a half-written import is rolled back instead of reported as success, and when parts are missing from your file the report offers to hide them instead of just saying nothing will be written.
